name: Maezono Chihaya
source:
The shortest girl in her school, with a smooth, young body, Chihaya looks just like a regular kid when not wearing her uniform.

The youngest of the four daughters and the smallest, she’s also the most aggressive and dominating of the lot.

She loves anime and cosplay. Having a fondness for female superheroes, this young pervert has made her own original superhero costume that she sometimes wears for sex.
